summary: Losses have deepened again into the afternoon, with the Nifty slipping toward 22,700 and volatility climbing, as broad selling outweighs the few pockets of support.

detail.tone: Weaker than the 1330 note: the Nifty has slipped from about 22,750 toward 22,700 and the India VIX is up 8.5% to 16.03.
watch: A break below 22,700 on the Nifty
Whether the VIX keeps climbing into the close
Q2 numbers from Adani Green, Indian Hotels and Eternal after hours

top.title: India VIX up 8.5% to 16.03
top.line: Volatility gauge climbs as the Sensex extends its slide to about 400 points.
more: Sensex was up about 800 pts intraday in the morning
Auto, bank and realty shares lead the declines
